battery_capacity_wh.label: Battery capacity
battery_capacity_wh.description: Total system capacity used by the SOC simulator.

max_charge_w.label: Max AC charge rate
max_charge_w.description: Peak wattage the device pulls from the wall when smart-charge engages.

inverter_overhead_pct.label: Inverter overhead
inverter_overhead_pct.description: Fraction of throughput lost as heat in DC→AC conversion. 0.10 (10%) is typical for modern LiFePO4 inverters.

parasitic_w.label: Parasitic baseline
parasitic_w.description: Constant draw that doesn't scale with AC throughput — BMS, idle inverter, pack-balancing, DC-bus losses. 50W is typical for single-unit setups; multi-pack rigs commonly fit 200-500W.

charge_efficiency.label: Charge efficiency
charge_efficiency.description: Stored Wh per input Wh. 0.85-0.95 is typical.

solar_coefficient.label: Solar coefficient
solar_coefficient.description: Effective panel array size — fitted from observed solar vs irradiance.
